description.value: Night Owl Cafe is a Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng in a Richmond strip mall, specializing in classic Cantonese comfort food including noodle soups, tossed noodles, and hearty breakfast combos. The menu leans into familiar Hong Kong cafe staples like pork sausage and egg noodles and preserved vegetable pork soup. It operates primarily as a breakfast and lunch spot with both dine-in and online ordering options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at nightowlcafe.ca was successfully fetched and confirms the business name, address (#104-8580 Cambie Road, Richmond, BC V6X 4J8), and phone (604-276-0576), none of which are present in OSM tags. The site confirms takeout via pickup, UberEats, and DoorDash. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM tags contain no address or phone number; both are available on the business website and should be added to the OSM record.
